# Suresh Kumar Mukhiya, PhD

Suresh Kumar Mukhiya is a Tech Lead in Bergen, Norway. He writes about software architecture, application security and the practical work of building and operating software.

## Current areas of work

- Secure application and API architecture
- OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and Microsoft Entra ID
- Threat modelling and OWASP ASVS
- SBOMs, dependency governance and software supply-chain security
- React, Python, FastAPI, Rust, PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server
- Azure cloud systems and AI-assisted development
